description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver for WS2812B LEDs using SPI, including functions for setting LED brightness and initializing the device.

classes.name: ws2812b_led
classes.description: Represents an individual WS2812B LED with multicolor capabilities.

classes.name: ws2812b_priv
classes.description: Private data structure for the driver, containing device-specific information.

methods.name: ws2812b_set_byte
methods.description: Converts a byte of data into a 3-byte SPI data sequence representing pulses for the WS2812B protocol.

methods.name: ws2812b_set
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the LED via the multicolor LED class interface.

methods.name: ws2812b_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver when the device is detected, sets up LEDs and SPI communication.

methods.name: ws2812b_remove
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the device is removed.
